# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.1.0

- Renamed the plugin from `ringcentral` to `ringcentral-phone`, and the display name from RingCentral to RingCentral Phone, matching RingCentral Chat.
- Renamed the MCP server key from `ringcentral` to `ringcentral-phone`. The endpoint is unchanged (`https://mcp.labs.ringcentral.com/ringex/phone`).

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `ringcentral` MCP server pointing at RingCentral's hosted RingEX Phone endpoint (`https://mcp.labs.ringcentral.com/ringex/phone`).
- Logo: RingCentral's mark from the `ringcentral` GitHub organization avatar, 256×256.
